GRAVITY_BASE_WEIGHTED_STRIKE.why: Weighted Strike: once per turn, on a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike hit while Body Lightening or Body Heavying is on, pay 1 and choose Heavying Blow or Lightening Blow (combat/ext/gravity.py).

TAL_GRAVITY_WEIGHT_SHIFT_BASE.why: Weight Shift: Body Lightening's key-ability attack roll after 10 feet of movement, Body Heavying's first-hit Proficiency Bonus damage, the free Neutral Weight action and the once-per-turn mode change (combat/ext/gravity.py); the modes themselves stay the compiled Bonus Action options.

tianxia.talent.gravity.heavy_weapon_body.why: Heavying Blow's d6s become d8s with a two-handed melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.gravitic_armor.why: While Gravitic Armor is on: Body Lightening Speed +10 more, Heavying Blow dice one step larger, Orbit-Breaking Guard free once a round (combat/ext/gravity.py); the armor itself stays the compiled Bonus Action.

tianxia.talent.gravity.anchor_breaking_p.why: A Heavying Blow may disrupt footing instead (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.moon_weight_incar.why: Both modes, Speed not lowered by Body Heavying, a free Weighted Strike each turn and both blows once a round (combat/ext/gravity.py); the Incarnation stays the compiled Bonus Action.

tianxia.talent.gravity.light_body_flurry.why: A free Lightening Blow once a fight after 10 feet of movement (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.light_body_rush.why: Dash/Disengage Bonus Actions for 1 with Body Lightening on, and a free Lightening Blow after 20 feet (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.moon_falling_coun.why: Reaction to a missed melee attack with Body Lightening on (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.orbit_breaking_gu.why: Reaction to a missed melee attack while Orbiting Guard is on (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.orbiting_guard.why: The once-a-round 5-foot step after a missed melee attack and the CL 5 AC (combat/ext/gravity.py); the guard stays the compiled Bonus Action.

TAL_GRAVITY_ANCHOR_STANCE.why: Forced movement against you is 10 feet shorter while Body Heavying; CL 5 shares it with an adjacent ally (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.mountain_crushing.why: A free paid action before moving: ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; the first melee hit after 10 feet: Strength save or Prone / pushed 10 feet (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.feather_body.why: Body Lightening's Speed increase becomes 15 feet, standing from Prone costs 5 feet, and a drop of 30 feet or less hurts nothing (combat/ext/gravity.py).

TAL_GRAVITY_FLIGHT_SUPPRESSION.why: A creature that is off the ground, can fly and starts its turn inside the area makes the area's Strength save; a failed save sets its Fly Speed to 0 until the start of its next turn (so a creature that cannot Hover falls) and a successful one halves its Fly Speed (combat/ext/gravity.py); the area stays the compiled Action.

TAL_GRAVITY_FALLING_HAMMER.why: A fall, jump down or drop of 10 feet or more earlier this turn lets a melee hit use Weighted Strike with no mode on and adds 1d6 Force (2d6 at CL 11); a descent of 30 feet or less costs no falling damage (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.weight_borrowing_.why: After a successful Shove or Grapple with Body Heavying on, pay 1 to put the target on any open square up to 5 feet away in any horizontal direction, or knock it Prone; 10 feet when it is already Grappled by you (combat/ext/gravity.py).

tianxia.talent.gravity.reverse_gravity_s.why: The Bonus Action keeps this turn's own drops free of falling damage (combat/ext/gravity.py); running along walls and ceilings is a ruling the table cannot make.

tianxia.talent.gravity.gravity_sense.why: +2 on a Cultivation Check made to get out of a Gravity effect, such as the one to teleport out of an Event Horizon Prison (combat/ext/gravity.py); sensing a distortion inside 120 feet is a GM call.

STARS_BASE_STARBOLT.why: Starbolt's Aligned Benefit: +30 feet against a creature bearing your Stellar Mark (combat/ext/stars.py).

STARS_TAL_FALLING_SPARK.why: One creature bearing your Stellar Mark in the area has Disadvantage on the save (combat/ext/stars.py).

tianxia.talent.stars.guiding_star.why: One ally's attack roll against the marked creature adds 1d4, once per round per creature (combat/ext/stars.py).

tianxia.talent.stars.constellation_guard.why: Seven stars: hostile damage puts one out, the +2 AC lasts while one burns, an Aligned turn start relights one (combat/ext/stars.py).

tianxia.talent.stars.seven_star_step.why: Passing within 5 feet of a creature bearing your Stellar Mark: Charisma save or no Reactions (combat/ext/stars.py).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.eye_water.why: Touch the Point: Apply a Point (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py; its effect combat/ext/pressure_points.py).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.stance_br.why: Touch the Point: Apply a Point (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.stolen_pu.why: Freeze owned movement effects; preexisting marks permit the printed half-Speed alternative.

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.weak_puls.why: Touch the Point: Apply a Point (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py).
covers: The reduction also applies if the first thing it gains is Temporary HP (the GM subtracts it; the table reduces healing).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.falling_g.why: Touch the Point: Close a Seal (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.shut_the_.why: Touch the Point: Close a Seal (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py; Dazed combat/ext/pressure_points.py).

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.locked_br.why: Touch the Point: Close a Seal (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py).

TAL_WRESTLING_HAMMERLOCK.why: Apply a Slam: Hammerlock (combat/ext/gu_wrestling.py; the hold combat/ext/wrestling.py).

TAL_WRESTLING_HEEL_TACTICS.why: Apply a Slam: Heel Tactics, expending Martial Focus (combat/ext/gu_wrestling.py).

TAL_WRESTLING_MERIDIAN_WRENCHING_LOCK.why: Apply a Slam: Meridian-Wrenching Lock, only on a creature Restrained through your Pin (combat/ext/gu_wrestling.py).

TAL_WRESTLING_IRON_CLINCH.why: +1 AC against and Advantage on forced-movement saves against the creature you Grapple (combat/ext/wrestling.py).

TAL_WRESTLING_COURT_OF_THE_CLOSED_DISTAN.why: The Court's step, Martial Focus and Half Cover lines (combat/ext/wrestling.py); the Court stays the compiled Bonus Action.

TAL_WRESTLING_SLIP_AND_STRIKE.why: A Bonus Action strike against a creature you voluntarily released (combat/ext/wrestling.py); the Reaction stays compiled.

TAL_GUARDIAN_PUNISHING_CHALLENGE.why: A Challenged creature's Disadvantaged attack costs it Psychic or Radiant damage equal to your CL (combat/ext/guardian.py).

TAL_GUARDIAN_FLUSH_OF_VICTORY.why: Temporary HP equal to your CL when a creature Challenged by you drops to 0 HP (combat/ext/guardian.py).

TAL_GUARDIAN_INESCAPABLE_CHALLENGE.why: A Wisdom save before a creature Challenged by you teleports farther away (combat/ext/guardian.py).

TAL_GUARDIAN_SWIFT_GUARDIAN.why: Challenge without spending the Bonus Action, for Martial Focus (combat/ext/guardian.py).

TAL_BERSERKER_MARAUDER.why: Adrenaline: Marauder's land Speed by CL (combat/ext/berserker.py; the toggle combat/ext/body_berserker.py).

TAL_BERSERKER_UNYIELDING_ADVANCE.why: Adrenaline: Unyielding Advance's Strength check against forced movement (combat/ext/berserker.py).

covers: activate two Adrenaline talents at once
ignore the AC penalty from one active Adrenaline talent
once per turn after taking damage, move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks
TAL_BERSERKER_WAR_GOD_INCARNATION.why: War-God Incarnation's Batter +2d10, already-Battered Exertion and Martial Focus on a kill (combat/ext/berserker.py); the 10-foot step after it takes damage is the same module's damage_committed event seam. 'activate two Adrenaline talents at once' and the ignored AC penalty are the Adrenaline toggle's own capacity and waiver (combat/ext/body_berserker.py, DOUBLE_STATES/AC_WAIVED_STATES); 'increase reach by 5 feet' is this record's own typed reach_bonus row (combat/ext/reach_bonus.py). The Incarnation stays the compiled Bonus Action.

covers: activate one Adrenaline talent without taking the normal -2 AC penalty
gain Resistance to forced movement, and deal double damage to unattended objects and temporary Barriers
TAL_BERSERKER_COURT_OF_THE_UNBROKEN_WARP.why: The Warpath's step after a kill or critical hit, its Martial Focus, its Resistance to being forced to move and its double damage to unattended objects and temporary Barriers (combat/ext/berserker.py: after_hit, forced_movement_reduction, object_packets). The Adrenaline talent it activates does not cost the usual -2 AC (combat/ext/body_berserker.py's AC_WAIVED_STATES). The 10-foot step after taking damage is the same module's damage_committed event seam. The Court stays the compiled Bonus Action.

TAL_BERSERKER_MERIDIAN_RENDING_BLOW.why: A melee critical hit: expend Martial Focus, Constitution save or a disabled arm/leg (combat/ext/berserker.py). The wing and tail rows of the printed table, and 'creatures without recognizable anatomy are immune', are the GM's again (AUTO70f1): this table tracks no body parts and has no anatomy gate, so the menu offers only the two structures it can enforce and says so at the blow and in the printed record.

TAL_BERSERKER_SANGUINE_INVIGORATION.why: Temporary HP equal to your CL after a melee or thrown kill of an eligible creature (combat/ext/berserker.py).

covers: Battered lasts until the end of your second turn
Your Exertion effects that normally last until the start of your next turn instead last until the start of your second turn after the attack.
TAL_BERSERKER_BEAT_DOWN.why: 'Battered lasts until the end of your second turn' is the batter effect's own printed length, extended through the general condition_turns hook (combat/ext/docket_maneuvers.py, documented in combat/ext/__init__.py); this fighter's own Exertion talents take the same second-turn expiry (combat/ext/berserker.py's exertion_expiry, read by combat/ext/gu_berserker.py).

covers: Instead of attacking a creature, Batter the ground and expend Martial Focus (Exertion, Ruin).
TAL_BERSERKER_SHATTER_EARTH.why: The compiled Action already is the printed alternative to attacking a creature (its own area-save zone makes the ground difficult terrain and drops creatures Prone) and already charges Martial Focus as its cost, so the line above is the table's own behaviour and not the GM's. The ground must be stone or softer material is a limitation of the battlefield, not a rule this table resolves.
